tabs.help.faq1.answer: Tap the Send button on the home screen, enter the recipient address and amount, then confirm the transaction. Ruma takes care of delivering the token where the recipient wants it.

help.title: Help
help.hero.title: Ruma is for sending money home
help.hero.body: Your balance is digital dollars. They hold their value when your local currency moves, and they reach whoever you want in minutes.
help.how.title: How does the money get there?
help.topics.title: What you can do
help.topic.sendBody: Pick who, say how much, and they receive it in their own currency — by Pix in Brazil, Nequi in Colombia, or a bank account. You see exactly what they get before you confirm, and that number is held for 15 minutes.
help.topic.qrBody: Ask the business the amount, then scan their code. Someone in the Ruma network pays the bill in local currency and it comes off your balance. You never need local cash.
help.topic.money: Put money in and take it out
help.topic.moneyBody: Add money from your bank, or move digital dollars in from a wallet you already use. Taking it out works the same way in reverse.
help.topic.cardBody: The card draws on the same balance you send with. Nothing to top up, and you can freeze it from the app whenever you want.
help.topic.limitsBody: You can open an account without handing over any documents. Verifying is optional and only exists to raise how much you can send.
help.costs.title: What it costs
help.faq.title: Common questions
help.faq.a1: They are USDC, worth one US dollar each, held in your own account on the Base network. Unlike a local currency account, the amount does not change when exchange rates move.
help.faq.q2: Do I need to know about crypto?
help.faq.a2: No. You put money in, send it, and the person receives their local currency. The network underneath is something you never have to think about.
help.faq.q3: How does the other person receive it?
help.faq.a3: In their own currency, through what they already use — Pix, Nequi, or a bank account. They do not need Ruma to receive money.
help.faq.q4: Why are you not asking for my ID?
help.faq.a4: Because you do not need it to start. Verification is optional and only raises your limits. You decide whether it is worth it.
help.faq.a5: Yes, while it has not arrived. The money stays in your balance and nothing reaches the recipient.
help.faq.q6: What if I send on the wrong network?
help.faq.a6: It is lost, and nobody can recover it — not us either. Only send digital dollars on Base, which is the network shown on the receive screen.
